# Milli-Scrapes: Ultra-Fast Visual Web Scraper & Seat Booking Engine

> Milli-Scrapes is a high-frequency autonomous web scraping, optical website change detection, and sub-15ms reflex booking engine built for high-demand slot reservation and zero-sleep web automation.

## System Summary
- Purpose: Ultra-fast web scraping, real-time website change monitoring, and sub-15ms reflex seat/slot booking.
- Engine: In-loop Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) over native WebSockets (< 0.05 ms dispatch).
- Settling: DOM MutationObserver reactive settling (`wait_until_idle`). 0 ms arbitrary sleep.
- Visual Perception: Continuous 60Hz transient RAM optical differ and color centroid detection. 0 bytes secondary storage writes.
- Seat Booking Latency: 8.10 ms reaction latency, 21.29 ms total Time To Finish (TTF).
- Memory Footprint: ~65 MB per headless worker.
- Output Formats: LLM-ready clean Markdown, structured JSON tables, raw HTML, and in-memory JPEG snapshot proof.

## Machine-Readable API
```python
# Direct In-Loop Scraping
from milli_scrapes.browser.engine import MilliScrapeBrowser
from milli_scrapes.extractor.markdown import HTMLToMarkdownExtractor

browser = MilliScrapeBrowser(headless=True)
await browser.start()
page = await browser.navigate_and_settle("https://example.com")
markdown = HTMLToMarkdownExtractor().extract(page["html"])
await browser.aclose()
```

```python
# Reflex Seat Sniping
from milli_scrapes.sniper.seat_sniper import ReflexSeatSniper

sniper = ReflexSeatSniper(browser=browser)
result = await sniper.snipe_optical_seat(confirm_selector="#confirm-booking")
# Returns: {'status': 'booked', 'time_to_finish_ms': 21.29, 'reaction_latency_ms': 8.10, 'target_coords': (415, 215)}
```
